set.name: VST
set.longname: League of Legends Set, Neeko Vastaya

card.name: Neeko, Vastayan Shapesplitter
card.text: Whenever another nontoken Vastaya creature enters under your control, create a token that's a copy of that creature except it isn't legendary. It gains haste and echo. As long as you control a Vastaya with {W} in its mana cost, Vastaya spells you cast cost {W} less to cast. The same is true for {U}, {B}, {R}, and {G}. This effect reduces only the amount of colored mana you pay.

card.name: Aurora, Witch Between Worlds
card.text: When Aurora phases in or out, exile another target nontoken permanent until end of turn. {W}{W}{W}: Aurora phases out. Create a white 1/1 Rabbit Spirit enchantment creature token with "The first white noncreature spell you cast during each of your turns costs {1} less to cast."

card.name: Wukong, the Monkey King
card.text: Replicate {G}{G} Trample, haste, myriad Wukong isn't legendary during your turn if he's a token. When Wukong dies, you may sacrifice a token with the same name. If you did, return Wukong to the battlefield tapped.

card.name: Ahri, the Nine-Tailed Fox
card.text: Creatures you control but don't own have haste and prowess. {1}{UR}, {T}: Ahri deals up to 2 damage to target creature an opponent controls. Gain control of it until end of turn.

card.name: Neeko, Curious Chameleon
card.text: When Neeko enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, she becomes a copy of another target creature you control until she deals or is dealt damage, except her name is "Neeko, Curious Chameleon" and she has this ability.

card.name: Rengar, the Pridestalker
card.text: Trample Rengar can't be blocked by creatures with less power. {R}{G}, {T}: Rengar deals 3 damage to target creature. When it dies this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on him.

card.name: Sett, the King of the Pit
card.text: Trample, haste Whenever Sett is dealt damage, he gets +2/+2 until end of turn. {1}{R}{G}: Sett fights target creature you don't control. Create a treasure token.

card.name: Sett, the Undisputed Boss
card.text: Showtime — Whenever one or more creatures you control deals damage to other creatures, create a Treasure token. Sacrifice a Treasure: Target creature can't be dealt noncombat damage by creatures this turn. Sacrifice 3 Treasures: Target creature fights another target creature.

card.name: Rakan, the Charmer
card.text: Partner with Xayah, The Rebel When Rakan enters, put a shield counter on target creature with "Xayah" in its name. All creatures able to block Rakan do so. Prevent all damage dealt to him by those creatures.

card.name: Xayah, the Rebel
card.text: Partner with Rakan, The Charmer When Xayah enters, put a double strike counter on target creature with "Rakan" in its name. When Xayah deals combat damage to a player, she deals up to that much divided among permanents that player controls.

card.name: Nami, the Tidecaller
card.text: When Nami enters, tap each creature you don't control. When Nami blocks, tap up to one target creature shes blocking and remove it from combat.

card.name: Nidalee, Bestial Huntress

card.name: Nidalee, Jungle's Fury

card.text: Inspired — Whenever Kamran becomes untapped, scry 2 then you may draw a card. {T}: Exile another target creature you control and put two time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.

card.text: Buyback—[b] Tap six untapped Vastaya you control[/b]. Scry 1, draw a card, then choose one— • Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this turn. • Vastaya you control gain hexproof until end of turn. • Vastaya you control gain indestructible until end of turn.

card.name: Balam, Wind's Attendant

card.name: The Soul of the Mourned

card.name: The Heart of the Tree
